params.body:
Elixir's half of a policy widening approved by passkey (control `policy/repair.go`, *A widening by passkey* in control's `docs/working-set.md`).

## What changes

- **`PolicyLog::repairOnly`**: control's `policy.RepairOnly` ported line for line next to the ported `narrower`, with `REPAIR_KINDS` copied from `policy.RepairKinds`. A draft may add kinds from that list (to a hand or one of its tasks) and resources for hands that exist and hold only repair kinds, and nothing else.
- **The draft is sent as `repairOnly`** only when the rule holds *and* the running gateway names Portal's key under its repair signers (`/v1/policy`, `Client::policy()` now returns `signers`). Before the carry-over the gateway would refuse Portal's signature, and a refused version blocks every later one.
- **The configuration names `signers.repair`**: Portal's key (`#portal`) from the DID document.

## Checked

- The repair rule on the same cases as control's `policy/repair_test.go`; the draft marked only with a repair signer on the gateway; a widening beyond a repair never marked; the written configuration carrying `repair`.
- `php artisan test`: 728 passed. PHPStan: no errors. Pint clean. Rebased on main after #240 (no overlap).

Companion PRs: control, portal, portal-cli (`workbench/repair-signer`).
params.title: Policy log: mark a repair-only draft, name Portal's repair key
